0.en: The lights flickered as a low hum passed through the floor. Sarah turned toward the far end of the laboratory.
0.id: Lampu-lampu berkedip ketika dengung rendah merambat lewat lantai. Sarah menoleh ke ujung lain laboratorium.

2.en: Jack was already out of his chair.

4.en: Sarah stood and picked up her tablet.

7.en: Being thirty-two weeks pregnant does not mean made of glass.
7.id: Hamil tiga puluh dua minggu bukan berarti aku terbuat dari kaca.

12.en: Jack glanced at her stomach and then met her eyes.
12.id: Jack melirik perut Sarah, lalu menatap matanya.

13.en: It means you're carrying something considerably more important than this laboratory.
13.id: Artinya kamu sedang mengandung sesuatu yang jauh lebih penting daripada laboratorium ini.

16.en: Jack opened his mouth, but Sarah pointed down the corridor.
16.id: Jack membuka mulut, tetapi Sarah menunjuk ke arah koridor.

18.en: Jack gave in and opened the door wider.
18.id: Jack mengalah dan membuka pintu lebih lebar.

20.en: Sarah fell into step beside him.

22.en: They hurried toward the main control room while another alarm sounded overhead.
22.id: Mereka bergegas menuju ruang kendali utama sementara satu alarm lagi meraung di atas kepala.

23.en: Warning. array power above standby threshold.
23.id: Peringatan. Daya Array di atas ambang siaga.

24.en: Jack tapped his wrist terminal and called the island utility station.
24.id: Jack mengetuk terminal pergelangannya dan menghubungi stasiun utilitas pulau.

25.en: Control, this is Bennett. Shut down power to TOMBS.
25.id: Kendali, ini Bennett. Putuskan daya ke TOMBS.

26.en: Lena Ortiz, the night-shift power technician, answered through his wrist terminal almost immediately.
26.id: Lena Ortiz, teknisi kelistrikan sif malam, menjawab lewat terminal pergelangannya nyaris seketika.

27.en: Jack, we were about to call you. We're seeing a massive draw from your building.
27.id: Jack, kami baru mau menghubungimu. Kami melihat tarikan daya yang luar biasa besar dari gedungmu.

30.en: Lena checked the readout on her end.

31.id: Empat belas megawatt dan terus naik.

32.en: Jack stopped so abruptly that Sarah nearly walked into him.
32.id: Jack berhenti begitu mendadak sampai Sarah nyaris menabraknya.

36.en: Sarah checked the figures on her tablet.

37.en: Yesterday's full test didn't use half that.
37.id: Uji penuh kemarin saja tidak sampai setengahnya.

40.en: Lena's voice returned through Jack's terminal.
40.id: Suara Lena kembali terdengar dari terminal Jack.

42.en: Possible network intrusion. Cut external access to the laboratory and disconnect TOMBS from the island grid.
42.id: Mungkin ada penyusupan jaringan. Putus akses eksternal ke laboratorium dan lepaskan TOMBS dari jaringan listrik pulau.

44.en: The corridor lights dimmed. For a moment, the building became almost silent, but the lights returned and the hum beneath their feet continued.
44.id: Lampu koridor meredup. Sesaat gedung itu nyaris sunyi, tetapi lampu menyala kembali dan dengung di bawah kaki mereka tak juga berhenti.

47.en: Jack looked toward the array chamber.
47.id: Jack menoleh ke arah ruang Array.

49.en: Lena went quiet for a beat.

51.en: Jack headed toward the array chamber.

52.id: Sepertinya itu jadi tema malam ini.

53.en: Sarah caught Jack's arm as they resumed walking.
53.id: Sarah meraih lengan Jack ketika mereka kembali berjalan.

59.en: Jack tapped the reactor status on his wrist display.
59.id: Jack mengetuk status reaktor di layar pergelangannya.

61.en: Sarah looked toward the humming chamber.
61.id: Sarah menatap ke arah ruang yang berdengung itu.

62.en: Then where is it getting the power?

65.en: They reached the main control room, where a reinforced window looked into the chamber beyond. At its center stood the TOMBS Array, the Temporal Object Manipulation and Boundary System. Several articulated rings surrounded a central platform. Under normal operation, the rings positioned themselves around a target while the system established a controlled boundary.
65.id: Mereka tiba di ruang kendali utama, tempat sebuah jendela yang diperkuat menghadap ke ruang Array di baliknya. Di tengah ruangan itu berdiri Array TOMBS, Temporal Object Manipulation and Boundary System. Beberapa cincin bersendi mengelilingi sebuah platform di tengah. Dalam operasi normal, cincin-cincin itu memosisikan diri di sekeliling sebuah target sementara sistem membentuk batas yang terkendali.

67.en: Sarah stared through the reinforced window, and her voice dropped.
67.id: Sarah menatap lewat jendela yang diperkuat, dan suaranya merendah.

70.en: Sarah turned from the rings to him.
70.id: Sarah mengalihkan pandangan dari cincin-cincin itu kepadanya.

71.id: Kamu tidak mengizinkan eksperimen apa pun, kan?

72.en: Jack moved toward the primary console.

74.en: The largest ring rotated into position while another slid sideways. Sarah moved to the console.
74.id: Cincin terbesar berputar ke posisinya sementara cincin lain bergeser ke samping. Sarah menghampiri konsol.

76.en: Jack pointed to the emitter controls.

78.en: Sarah worked the controls and shook her head.
78.id: Sarah mengutak-atik kendali itu, lalu menggeleng.

81.en: Then we'll do it the old-fashioned way.
81.id: Kalau begitu, kita pakai cara lama.

82.en: He pulled the physical shutdown lever, and the room went dark.
82.id: Ia menarik tuas pemutus fisik, dan ruangan itu pun gelap.

84.en: Sarah exhaled and loosened her grip on the console.
84.id: Sarah mengembuskan napas dan mengendurkan cengkeramannya pada konsol.

86.en: Jack kept his hand on the shutdown lever.

88.en: A light blinked inside the chamber, then another. The rings began moving again.
88.id: Sebuah lampu berkedip di dalam ruang Array, lalu satu lagi. Cincin-cincin itu mulai bergerak lagi.

91.en: Jack checked the lever and its indicator.
91.id: Jack memeriksa tuas itu dan indikatornya.

93.id: Sarah memperhatikan cincin-cincin itu berputar makin cepat.

95.en: Jack moved back toward the console.

98.id: Yang satu ini kelihatannya teguh sekali pendiriannya.

99.en: The emergency lights switched on. Jack rushed back to the console, which should have been dead. Instead, the screen was filling with data.
99.id: Lampu darurat menyala. Jack bergegas kembali ke konsol, yang seharusnya sudah mati. Namun, layarnya justru mulai dipenuhi data.

101.en: Sarah leaned closer to the new warning.
101.id: Sarah mencondongkan badan ke arah peringatan baru itu.

109.en: Sarah leaned closer. The values flickered, vanished, and returned as unreadable placeholders.
109.id: Sarah mendekat. Nilai-nilai itu berkedip, lenyap, lalu muncul lagi sebagai tanda pengganti yang tak terbaca.

111.en: Jack tried to reopen the raw parameters.
111.id: Jack mencoba membuka ulang parameter mentahnya.

113.en: Sarah pulled up the mapping controls. A red outline appeared for less than a second, too fast to resolve, then the map cleared itself.
113.id: Sarah membuka kendali pemetaan. Sebuah garis luar berwarna merah muncul kurang dari sedetik, terlalu cepat untuk terlihat jelas, lalu peta itu kosong dengan sendirinya.

114.en: Jack stared at the empty display.
114.id: Jack menatap layar yang kosong itu.

116.en: I didn't do it the first time.
116.id: Yang pertama tadi juga bukan aku.

117.id: Meski begitu, Sarah tetap mencoba perintah itu.

119.en: Jack opened a second diagnostic path. The system returned only one line.
119.id: Jack membuka jalur diagnostik kedua. Sistem hanya membalas dengan satu baris.

121.en: Sarah looked toward the array chamber.
121.id: Sarah menoleh ke arah ruang Array.

123.en: That's what I want to know.

125.en: Lena, keep the laboratory isolated. Don't sound a settlement alarm yet.
125.id: Lena, biarkan laboratorium tetap terisolasi. Jangan bunyikan alarm permukiman dulu.

127.en: No. But I don't know what we'd be telling people to do, and I don't want anyone running toward whatever this is.
127.id: Tidak. Tapi aku tidak tahu apa yang harus kita suruh orang-orang lakukan, dan aku tidak mau ada yang malah berlari mendekati entah apa ini.

129.en: Quiet containment until we know the boundary.
129.id: Penahanan senyap sampai batas itu jelas.

130.en: Jack looked back at the screen.

131.en: Exactly. If anything changes outside this building, call us.
131.id: Tepat. Kalau ada yang berubah di luar gedung ini, hubungi kami.

133.en: The laboratory remained quiet beyond the muted warning tones at their consoles. Somewhere outside, nearly five hundred people slept through an emergency they did not know existed.
133.id: Laboratorium tetap sunyi, kecuali nada peringatan yang teredam di konsol-konsol mereka. Di suatu tempat di luar sana, hampir lima ratus orang tidur lelap di tengah keadaan darurat yang bahkan tidak mereka ketahui.

136.en: Jack searched through the manual overrides.

138.en: Sarah pulled up the emitter load.
138.id: Sarah memunculkan beban emitor di layar.

139.id: Bisa kita buat emitornya kelebihan beban?

143.en: Maybe good, or maybe everyone-inside-the-field-dies bad?
143.id: Mungkin dalam arti bagus, atau mungkin dalam arti semua-orang-di-dalam-medan-tewas?

147.en: Jack opened another diagnostic window and searched for a route into the controls.
147.id: Jack membuka jendela diagnostik lain dan mencari jalan masuk ke kendali.

160.id: Ada orang yang bukan sekadar mengaktifkan TOMBS.
